lines.text: Solomon received 666 talents of gold each year and made two hundred large shields of hammered gold.
Solomon made a great ivory throne overlaid with pure gold, and the ships of Tarshish brought apes and peacocks.
All the kings of the earth sought Solomon to hear the wisdom that God had put in his heart.
Solomon had 4,000 stalls for horses and chariots and reigned over all the kings from the Euphrates to Babylon.
Solomon reigned in Jerusalem thirty years, was buried in the city of his father David, and his son Rehoboam reigned.
